title: NCCL Deep Dive: The GPU Journey of an AllReduce Collective
titleZh: NCCL 源码解读：一个 AllReduce 的 GPU 旅程
categoryZh: AI Infra 与大模型系统工程
summary: A 25-chapter tour-de-force of NVIDIA NCCL: from topology graph discovery and algorithm tuning to multi-channel kernel scheduling, device-side LL/LL128/Simple protocols, and InfiniBand GPUDirect RDMA.
summaryZh: 全书 25 章系统拆解 NVIDIA NCCL 通信库内核：从初始化拓扑图搜索、算法协议选型，到多 channel 任务调度、CUDA Kernel 启动、LL/LL128/Simple 数据搬运与 InfiniBand GPUDirect RDMA。
